title: Tuplewise refinement on the pushed-forward target resolution
statement: Let $f:X'\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $U=(U_i)_{i\in I}$ and $U'=(U'_j)_{j\in I'}$ arbitrary families of opens, and $c:I'\to I$ a map with $U'_j\subseteq f^{-1}(U_{c(j)})$. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $I^\bullet$ an injective resolution of $f^*F$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions, def-pc-module-pullback], and $\gamma$ a cochain map with the prescribed refinement tuple formula [def-sc-cech-refinement-cochain-map]. Let $a:\Gamma(X',I^\bullet)\simeq\Gamma(X,f_*I^\bullet)$ be an isomorphism of additive-group complexes whose inverse components are the canonical top-open restrictions. Put $P=f_*I^\bullet$ and $\eta:F\to P^0$ equal to the adjunction unit followed by the pushed-forward resolution augmentation. For each $p\in\mathbf N$ there exists an additive map $s:H^p(\operatorname{Tot}\check C(U,P))\to H^p(\operatorname{Tot}\check C(U',I^\bullet))$ satisfying $H^p(\alpha_P)s=H^p(a^{-1})H^p(\alpha_I)$ and $H^p(\beta_\eta)s=H^p(\gamma)H^p(\beta_I)$ [def-sc-cech-complex-augmentations], with the canonical forgetting-scalars homology isomorphisms inserted at the section ends. No source resolution, lift, injective replacement, or covering hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Apply exists_unique_cechPushforward_tuple_total to the target resolution complex, obtaining a cochain map t of forgotten totals and its formula on every bidegree summand. The component maps are explicitly constructed, and no arbitrary existence witness is stored in a definition.

For alpha, the summand formula at (n,0) reduces the square to equality of two composites of restrictions of global sections. Prove moduleCechZero_tuple using the product projections, then use presheaf functoriality and uniqueness of open inclusions. The hypothesis ha identifies the top-open restriction with a inverse. For beta, use the formula at (0,n), the component formula for gamma and naturality of I augmentation. These prove the two cochain squares directly.

Define s by conjugating H(t) with the source inverse and target forward canonical forgetting-scalars homology isomorphisms. Apply HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp to each cochain square, and ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality and mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality to its two augmentation maps. Associativity gives the two required equalities; cechRefinementHomology is precisely the same conjugation applied to gamma. The private forgotten_homology_square proves this calculation for arbitrary module coefficient rings.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cechRefinement_pushforward_total
    {X X' : Scheme.{v}} (f : X' ⟶ X) {ι ι' : Type v}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (U' : ι' → X'.Opens)
    (refine : ι' → ι) (hrefine : ∀ i, U' i ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U (refine i))
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback f).obj F)) (p : ℕ)
    (gamma : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat) ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X', ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          ((cechComplexFunctor U').obj ((tensorPullback f).obj F).presheafModuleCat))
    (hgamma : IsCechRefinementMap f U U' refine hrefine F gamma)
    (a : ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X'.toRingedSpace ⋙
        forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          I.cocomplex ≅
      ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace ⋙
        forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex))
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, a.inv.f n = (Scheme.Modules.presheaf (I.cocomplex.X n)).map
      (eqToHom (by simp) : (⊤ : X'.Opens) ⟶ f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : X.Opens)).op) :
    let P := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let e := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}
    let e' := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X', ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}
    let S := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∃ s : e.obj (((moduleCechTotalFunctor U).obj P).homology p) ⟶
        e'.obj (((moduleCechDouble U' I).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology p),
      e.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechComplexAlpha U P) p) ≫ s =
        (((S.obj P).sc p).mapHomologyIso e).inv ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap a.inv p ≫
          (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).sc p).mapHomologyIso e').hom ≫
          e'.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechAlpha U' I) p) ∧
      e.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (moduleCechComplexBeta U P (cechPushforwardAugmentation f F I)
            (cechPushforwardAugmentation_d f F I)) p) ≫ s =
        cechRefinementHomology gamma p ≫
          e'.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (moduleCechBeta U' I) p)
